description: A monophonic additive voice of 32 partials, with the ratios of the partials and the wave each one is played with read from a file

params.text: Picks the set of ratios the 32 partials are tuned to, from the set in the file
Picks which wave each partial is played with, from the set in the file
Damps the higher partials on a falling curve, 0 to 10; at 0 the strengths at the two Amps jacks are used as they come

inputs.text: Sets the strengths of the first sixteen partials, one channel per partial
Sets the strengths of the seventeenth to the thirty-second partials, one channel per partial; the panel letters this jack 15-31 while it starts at the seventeenth
The pitch, 1V per octave with 0V at middle C
Sets the damping by voltage in place of the Dmp knob, 0-10V, and moves the knob while it is patched

notes: nothing sounds until strengths are patched into the Amps jacks; with both empty every partial is at zero
the ratios and the waves come from res/addsynth_default.json in the installed plugin folder; an addsynth.json placed beside it is read instead, and is used only if it loads without errors
the module is monophonic: only the first channel of the V/Oct jack is read

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads silence.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads silence.
inputs.2: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Dmp knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.
